statement: The x-readers field leaves the 825 registry key files: the readers are derived from the code (registry_readers.sites), so the declared list and the check that it equals the code are retired, with scripts/scaffold config-key no longer asking for --reader.
note: The hand fix (registry_readers.py --fix) ran three times in PADRAO-DEV F1 alone (friction of 16/11); since F4a the selection no longer depends on the declaration.
